short_description: An AI agent that automatically builds AI models.
approved_facts: It runs an agent loop that analyzes a task, designs models, writes code, trains them, tunes hyperparameters, evaluates performance, and iteratively improves models.
The repository README says AIBuildAI is #1 on OpenAI MLE-Bench.
The quick start documents a Linux x86_64 installation path and use of the aibuildai CLI.
The project accepts task instructions and data directories, and includes task markdowns under tasks/.
Example tasks in the repo include protein-ec-prediction, TGS Salt Identification Challenge, wound segmentation, and Spaceship Titanic.
The README shows Anthropic API key setup in the quick start instructions.
